prompt.zh-TW: 關於課程參考值（例如{{term:tm_9e1rb64c|plain}}不超過 {{percent:0.5|digits=0}}、{{term:tm_8eyx0srs|plain}}不低於 {{percent:1|digits=0}}），下列哪些說法正確？
prompt.en: Which of these statements about the course reference values (for example a {{term:tm_9e1rb64c|plain}} of no more than {{percent:0.5|digits=0}} or a {{term:tm_8eyx0srs|plain}} of at least {{percent:1|digits=0}}) are correct?

text.zh-TW: 它們是課程整理的經驗值，不是法規規定的門檻
text.en: They are rules of thumb compiled by the course, not thresholds set by law

feedback.zh-TW: 正確。法規沒有規定這些比率的門檻，參考值只提供一個比較的起點。
feedback.en: Correct. The law sets no thresholds for these ratios; the reference values only give you a starting point for comparison.

text.zh-TW: 不同產業的合理區間不同，判讀時要和同業比較
text.en: Reasonable ranges differ by industry, so compare with peers when interpreting

feedback.zh-TW: 正確。銀行、航空、營建這類產業的負債比率普遍比一般商店高，同一個數字在不同產業意義不同。
feedback.en: Correct. Banks, airlines and construction firms commonly carry higher debt ratios than an ordinary shop; the same number means different things in different industries.

text.zh-TW: 教科書常見的說法和課程參考值可能不一樣，兩者都只是參考
text.en: Common textbook figures may differ from the course reference values, and both are only guides

feedback.zh-TW: 正確。例如流動比率就有不同的常見說法；網站把課程參考值和常見說法並列，讓你知道它們都不是標準答案。
feedback.en: Correct. The current ratio, for example, has several common benchmarks; the site shows the course value alongside them so you know none of them is the right answer.

text.zh-TW: 只要指標落在參考值內，就不必再看其他報表
text.en: As long as a ratio falls within the reference range, there is no need to look at the other statements

feedback.zh-TW: 參考值內只表示這一個指標沒有亮紅燈。負債比率正常的公司仍可能現金不夠或獲利很差，三張報表還是要一起看。
feedback.en: Being within the range only means this one ratio has not raised a flag. A company with a normal debt ratio may still be short of cash or barely profitable; the three statements still have to be read together.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_czyn}}、{{option:o_mz1b}}與{{option:o_yarm}}都在說同一件事：參考值是幫助你提問的工具。{{option:o_vwwc}}把參考值當成終點，正好是參考值最容易被誤用的方式。
explanation.en: {{option:o_czyn}}, {{option:o_mz1b}} and {{option:o_yarm}} all say the same thing: reference values are tools that help you ask questions. {{option:o_vwwc}} treats them as the finish line, which is exactly how they are most often misused.
